mandatory_refinement.status: Resolved in final author contract; frozen proposal preserved
mandatory_refinement.finding: The cutoff input specified local type masses/potential-type law, while the task called the weighted effects global ATEs. Local facts alone do not define a full-population global effect.
mandatory_refinement.required_author_text: Define running score R uniformly distributed on[-1,1], independent of principal type, with eligibility Z=1{R>=0}. Types always/complier/never have population probabilities(1/5,3/5,1/5), and their stated potential outcomes are constant across the entire score support in each of the two complete teaching worlds. Receipt is1 for always, Z for compliers,0 for never. Outcomes follow consistency and exclusion. This explicit full-population extension makes the two global ATEs3 and14/5 well-defined and preserves every displayed local/observed numerical anchor. State that this score-invariant type law is an additional construction, not inferred from cutoff continuity.

proof_judgment: D1 ratio LLN/CLT and scalar QMLE strict optimum/delta require independent whole units and positive/nonzero moment denominators; the contract supplies these.
D2 exposure HT, conditional trends and effect-sensitivity constructions are sound. Local-to-global scope is repaired by the explicit complete running-score law above.
D3 finite Gaussian innovation map proves the precise exact distribution; structural observational equivalence and sharp policy set follow from explicit invariance.

D4 bounded unequal folds use separate training-sample conditioning and proportional sizes; mean-score pooling follows n_k/N. The minimum-p example disproves ordinary unselected super-uniformity, not by itself an exact trimmed-BH FDR calculation.

D5 version metadata is stipulated treatment-label-blind; complete selection is part of the statistic even when prespecified. Transport oracle and unreleased composition are conditional and separate from a claim of full empirical replication.

coverage: All12 outcomes have genuine evidence with expressly bounded depth. Bayesian/MCMC/lasso, staggered/comparative designs and dynamic/simulation detail remain required in Form B/project; this form alone is not comprehensive assessment.
